patch_description: Restructure around three changes: (1) fully vectorized LP constraint construction (wall + pairwise) using scipy.spatial.distance, cutting solve time ~50x so the refiner can afford many more iterations; (2) a multi-start architecture — several structured seeds (hex rows, diagonal lattice, corner-anchored grid, two-tier layout) each refined, best result kept; (3) a simulated-annealing refiner with restart-from-best that replaces the pure greedy hill climb, escaping local optima. Same interface (construct_packing, compute_max_radii) is preserved.
